# Local browser dependencies

Pinned npm distributions: Vega 5.33.0, Vega-Lite 5.23.0, Vega Embed 6.29.0.
The adjacent licence files retain their BSD copyright notices.

Fraunces and Manrope variable Latin fonts were obtained from Fontsource packages
5.2.8, with the original SIL Open Font License files retained in `fonts/`.
Font files are self-hosted; no third-party font requests are made by the page.

See `package-lock.json` for package integrity and exact dependency versions.
Rebuild copies using the same distribution files; do not modify the font binaries.
